source: Static game config (RelicData, AccessoryData); rules checked against a real account's gear.

rules.mainStat: value at level L = sum(byLevel[0..L]). Depends on slot, stat and rank (stars) only, not rarity.
rules.subStatRoll: roll k of a substat (0 = when it appears, 1-4 = each later upgrade of it) adds baseByRoll[k] x quality. Flat stats are rounded to a whole number on every roll.
rules.milestoneRule: At each milestone the item gains a new substat if it has fewer than 4, otherwise one existing substat is upgraded (its next roll).
rules.flatHealthScale: HealthFlat values are already multiplied by 10 in this file (the config stores 1/10).
rules.highRankServerSide: Upgrades of Five-star and higher items are decided by the server; the tables still apply.

accessories.note: Accessories follow the same rules. They have no set bonuses; see sets.json for gear sets.

unconfirmed: Quality weights are not in the config; 0.7/0.8/0.9/1.0 each appeared ~25% of the time (7,554 rolls).
Which substat a milestone upgrades, and which new stat is added, look uniformly random among the slot's allowed stats (not in the config).
